meta.notes_zh: AA = Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0.1；Vals = Vals Index v2.2；TB4 = Vals 独立测 Terminal-Bench 4.0（mini-swe-agent）。cost_per_task 单位均为 USD。LMArena 全部未取到。

notes.zh: xAI 已更名经营：官网署名 SpaceX Super Intelligence LLC（SpaceXSI），Model Card 说 SpaceXAI 是 XAI LLC 的 DBA 名，AA 标作 SpaceXAI。2026-06-01 至今的文本模型：Grok 4.5（7-08 API / 7-16 博文）、Grok 4.6（8-12）、Grok 4.7（9-21，当前旗舰）；Grok 4.7 Fast 只在 Cursor / Grok Build。没有 Grok 5。专用型号：Grok Voice 2.0（7-29）→ Voice 3.0（10-14）、Voice Transcribe 2.0（9-17）、Imagine Image 2.0（8-07）/ 2.0 Low（11-02）、Imagine Video 1.5（6-16）、Composer 2.5（6-01）；未单列。Google / OpenAI / Anthropic 的发布表里没找到 Grok 对照分。
notes.en: xAI now operates as SpaceX Super Intelligence LLC (SpaceXSI); its model cards call SpaceXAI a DBA of XAI LLC, and AA lists it as SpaceXAI. Text models since 2026-06-01: Grok 4.5 (API Jul 8 / post Jul 16), Grok 4.6 (Aug 12), Grok 4.7 (Sep 21, current flagship); Grok 4.7 Fast is Cursor / Grok Build only. No Grok 5. Specialized models (Grok Voice 2.0 → 3.0, Voice Transcribe 2.0, Imagine Image 2.0 / 2.0 Low, Imagine Video 1.5, Composer 2.5) are not listed separately. No Grok scores found in Google / OpenAI / Anthropic launch tables.

notes.zh: Muse 产品线：Muse Spark（2026-04-08）→ 1.1 / 1.2 / 1.3（1.3 于 9-02，$1.25/$4.25，AA v5.0.1 36.6、$2.39/题；未单列，因每家上限 4 个）；Muse Glimmer（8-10，30B 开放权重 Apache 2.0，AA 6.3）；Muse Wonder 与 Wonder Full（10-12）；Muse Spark Open（10-15）；Muse Ember（11-09）。Meta 发布表的对照对象是 GPT-6 Astra、Claude Fable 5.1、Claude Opus 5.5（Wonder）和 Claude Haiku 5.5、GPT-6 Luna（Ember）；没在其他厂商发布表里找到 Muse 的对照分。
notes.en: Muse lineup: Muse Spark (2026-04-08) → 1.1 / 1.2 / 1.3 (1.3 on Sep 2, $1.25/$4.25, AA v5.0.1 36.6, $2.39/task; not listed separately because of the 4-model cap); Muse Glimmer (Aug 10, 30B open weights under Apache 2.0, AA 6.3); Muse Wonder and Wonder Full (Oct 12); Muse Spark Open (Oct 15); Muse Ember (Nov 9). Meta's launch tables compare against GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Opus 5.5 (Wonder), and Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6 Luna (Ember). No Muse scores found in other vendors' launch tables.

It moves to a larger new base model (reportedly ~2.1T parameters) with a longer RL run weighted toward multi-hour tasks. models.summary_zh: Muse Spark 的开放权重版（816B 总参 / 42B 激活 MoE，1M 上下文，原生多模态），Meta 自称「美国迄今最强的开放权重模型」，两台 M5 Ultra Mac Studio 就能跑。这是 Meta 自 Llama 之后重新放出大模型权重，许可证改为有限商用的 Muse Model License。
models.summary_en: The open-weight release of Muse Spark: an 816B-total / 42B-active MoE with a 1M context that's natively multimodal, billed by Meta as the most capable US open-weight model to date and able to run on two M5 Ultra Mac Studios. It marks Meta's return to releasing large model weights after Llama, now under the more restrictive Muse Model License.
